note: One people, tradition or figure from history for the Pacific, the far southern islands and Antarctica. Heard Island and the Siachen Glacier are left out: nobody lives on either.

ASM.name: Matai
ASM.note: A village chief and speaker, chosen by the family to talk for it.

ATC.name: Rote fisherman
ATC.note: Sailors from Rote have fished these reefs for three hundred years.

COK.name: Ura dancer
COK.note: Hips that keep the drum's time exactly, and nothing else moving.

FJI.name: Beqa firewalker
FJI.note: One island's families walk barefoot over white-hot stones.

FSM.name: Yapese stone money carrier
FSM.note: Money the size of a door, which stays put when it changes owner.

GUM.name: CHamoru
GUM.note: The first people of the Marianas, and the fastest sailing canoes in the world.

KIR.name: Kiribati dancer
KIR.note: Arms held out and still, like a frigatebird riding the wind.

MHL.name: Stick chart navigator
MHL.note: A map of sticks and shells that shows where the waves bend.

MNP.name: Carolinian canoe sailor
MNP.note: Open ocean crossed by the stars, with no instrument at all.

NCL.name: Kanak
NCL.note: The first people of these islands, and their tall round houses.

NFK.name: Bounty descendant
NFK.note: Families descended from the mutineers, with a language of their own.

NIU.name: Hiapo maker
NIU.note: Cloth beaten from bark and painted with fine spidery lines.

NRU.name: Frigatebird keeper
NRU.note: Wild seabirds tamed to fly out and come home again.

PCN.name: Bounty descendant
PCN.note: Fifty people on one rock, all from the same nine sailors.

PLW.name: Palauan storyboard carver
PLW.note: A whole legend carved along one plank of wood.

PNG.name: Huli wigman
PNG.note: Wigs grown from their own hair and decorated with everlasting daisies.

PYF.name: ʻŌteʻa dancer
PYF.note: Drums so fast the hips can barely keep up.

SLB.name: Shell money maker
SLB.note: Shells ground into beads and strung — still used to buy things.

TON.name: Lakalaka dancer
TON.note: A whole village in a line, dancing a poem with their hands.

TUV.name: Fatele dancer
TUV.note: Everyone sings, and the box they drum on is an empty crate.

VUT.name: Naghol land diver
VUT.note: A tower of sticks, two vines round the ankles, and a dive.

WLF.name: Wallisian dancer
WLF.note: Dances for the king, in mats and scented oil.

WSM.name: Tufuga tā tatau
WSM.note: Tattoo masters who work with a comb of bone and a mallet.

ATA.name: Polar explorer
ATA.note: Wooden huts, sledges and dogs — and a race for the South Pole.

ATF.name: Kerguelen sealer
ATF.note: Men left for a year on the islands of desolation.

IOT.name: Chagossian
IOT.note: Islanders of the Chagos, who fished these lagoons for generations.

MDV.name: Bodu beru drummer
MDV.note: A big drum, a circle of singers, and a dance that speeds up and up.

MUS.name: Séga dancer
MUS.note: Feet sliding on sand — in this dance they never leave the ground.

SGS.name: South Georgia whaler
SGS.note: A rusting station in a bay full of penguins and elephant seals.

SHN.name: Saint Helena flax worker
SHN.note: Rope made from flax on the loneliest island in the Atlantic.

SYC.name: Moutya dancer
SYC.note: A drum warmed over a beach fire, and dancing until it cools.
